title: Jump In
description: Transcribed from src/match/rules/jump_in.cpp as spec 13.3 prescribes: a deny on out-of-turn plays (shipped by vanilla as vanilla:turn_order) plus an allow entry rescuing an identical card. The play predicates come from WP7e (plays_identical_to_top = same colour AND value as the discard top). legacy jump_in.cpp:22-31 also makes the jumper the current player, so an accepted identical response redirects the turn to @responder (WP7 10.3 redirect_turn) after the response play resolves. The response is offered through a spec 12.1 window opened after a play; the allow entry above is what makes the out-of-turn response legal.
